She has already learned a lot during these few months. What interesting things will happen to her in the future? Let’s continue to follow Elsie’s work and life in China, experiencing her joys, challenges, and personal growth. 

This course is based on the Business Chinese Test (BCT) and progressively increases in difficulty. This engaging story will help you review what you have learned in the past and easily master new vocabulary and grammar points. We will dig deep into Elsie’s work and life in Shenzhen and learn about workplace culture in China. It is suitable for students at HSK4, students preparing for the BCT, or those planning to come to China for work. course.description:

The course covers a variety of lessons from basic financial knowledge to complex business communication. You will learn how to effectively communicate in a business environment, understand stock market dynamics, explore investment strategies, and gain a deep understanding of the concept of angel investing through role-playing, case analysis, and actual conversations.

If you are curious about the world of business and finance, this course will equip you with practical knowledge and language skills. Through this course, you will deepen your understanding of business and finance concepts and learn how to use Chinese in practical situations, providing benefits for your academic and professional endeavors.

She has already learned a lot during these few months. What interesting things will happen to her in the future? Let’s continue to follow Elsie’s work and life in China, experiencing her joys, challenges, and personal growth. 

This course is based on the Business Chinese Test (BCT) and progressively increases in difficulty. This engaging story will help you review what you have learned in the past and easily master new vocabulary and grammar points. We will dig deep into Elsie’s work and life in Shenzhen and learn about workplace culture in China. It is suitable for students at HSK4, students preparing for the BCT, or those planning to come to China for work. To learn more about Elsie’s life when she first arrived in China, check out Business Course 1.

course.description:
This course continues from Newbie Course 4. The course content revolves around conversations between Anne and her friends in various situations, such as traveling, falling ill, studying, and shopping. These daily conversations will help you quickly master the basic grammar and vocabulary needed to communicate in Chinese. You will also learn a wide range of everyday expressions, such as asking about someone's health, expressing gratitude, and discussing plans.

Following the previous course, where Anne introduced Gao Tian to Li Xiaobei, our story continues to unfold. From Anne's parents visiting China to her daily life with friends, the plot is rich and colorful. You will witness how Anne adapts to life in a foreign land, makes new friends, and explores Chinese culture and traditions.

Elsie is a 25-year-old American woman who works for a branch of a Chinese trading company in the U.S. It has now been a few months since came to Shenzhen, China for work. course.description:
This course builds on the previous Elementary Course, following Anne and her friends as they go about their lives in Beijing. From the tension of a Chinese speech competition to the warmth of friendship, from leisurely strolls in the park to the ups and downs of youth, you’ll follow Anne on her journey through a variety of everyday situations.

The course focuses on practical Chinese expressions, such as showing concern and giving advice, describing health conditions, discussing future plans, and making comparisons.  The Intermediate 1 and 2 courses systematically integrate the core vocabulary and grammar points of HSK 3, helping you confidently handle more complex life situations and achieve the leap from basic expression to fluent communication.

course.description:
Elsie is a 25-year-old American woman who works for a branch of a Chinese trading company in the U.S. It has now been a few months since came to Shenzhen, China for work. She has already learned a lot during these few months. What interesting things will happen to her in the future? Let’s continue to follow Elsie’s work and life in China, experiencing her joys, challenges, and personal growth. 

This course is based on the Business Chinese Test (BCT) and progressively increases in difficulty. This engaging story will help you review what you have learned in the past and easily master new vocabulary and grammar points. We will dig deep into Elsie’s work and life in Shenzhen and learn about workplace culture in China. It is suitable for students at HSK4, students preparing for the BCT, or those planning to come to China for work. To learn more about Elsie’s life when she first arrived in China, check out Business Course 1.

course.description:
Are you curious about how technology and engineering impact our daily lives? Or do you want to know how to discuss cutting-edge technology and engineering topics in Chinese? This course covers everything from basic conversation skills on the work floor to advanced alternative fuel vehicle technology, giving you a deeper understanding of all aspects of engineering. The course will not only enhance your understanding of technical and engineering concepts but also teach you related Chinese vocabulary and expressions.  

This course is designed for students who are passionate about engineering and Chinese learners who want to improve their technical and engineering vocabulary. Through this course, you will be able to gain a deeper understanding of the world of engineering and talk about related topics fluently in Chinese.
course.title: Technology and Engineering

course.description:
Cold winter days are a good time to stay at home and watch a movie. You can also learn Chinese while watching movies! 

The movies in this series are Chinese movies that showcase the country. Through these movies, you can learn about topics such as the Chinese New Year travel rush, Chinese cuisine, China’s economy, and dating in China. Not only are these movies highly acclaimed in China, but the language in the movies is relatively easy to understand, making them suitable for students studying Chinese. Most of the movies can also be found on YouTube. Let’s watch movies and learn Chinese together!

course.description:
This is our course aimed at complete beginners of learning Chinese. We start off with basic greetings, and gradually move to more complex sentences, with lots of repetition to help you retain what you learn throughout the course.

In the course you will meet Anne who has come to China for university studies. When she arrives in China she gets to know a boy called Li and we follow along with the dialogue between them.

After completing this course, you will have a basic understanding of the Chinese language and be able to greet people and have basic conversations in Chinese. Once you're done, we recommend part 2 of the same series.

course.description:
This course continues to tell the story of Anne, Xiaobei, and Gao Tian's life in Beijing, and introduces a new friend, Bai Xue. Through their eyes, you’ll experience even more real-life moments: the joy of finding a lost wallet, a fun encounter with pandas at the zoo, helping a friend move, and exploring the beauty of Chinese landscape painting and the Mid‑Autumn Festival.

Through these engaging stories, you’ll learn how to deal with unexpected situations, ask for help when you need it, talk about your feelings, and discuss interesting cultural topics. The course fully covers the core vocabulary and grammar points of HSK 3, helping you practice Chinese in natural contexts, improve your communication skills, and make the leap from basic conversations to confident self‑expression.

course.description:
After returning from his training, Sun Wukong continues to write his legend—he defeats the demon king, obtains the Golden Cudgel, alters the Book of Life and Death, and even challenges the authority of the Heavenly Palace, proclaiming himself the “Great Sage Equal to Heaven”. However, the pride that comes with power gradually causes him to lose himself. What, then, is true strength? Let’s follow in Sun Wukong’s footsteps and witness how a mischievous stone monkey becomes a legendary hero of great courage and strength!
This story is adapted from one of China’s Four Classic Novels, “Journey to the West”, and is based on a vocabulary of 1,000 characters.

course.description:
This course is the next level in the Elementary series. It continues to follow Anne’s life in China through a series of authentic and heartwarming everyday stories that help you naturally immerse yourself in Chinese language and culture. The lessons cover practical topics like campus life, everyday interactions, traditional festivals, and asking for directions. The language is clear and easy to follow, with sentence patterns that match real-life conversation.

The Newbie and Elementary courses together form a complete learning system that covers all the core vocabulary for HSK 3.0 Level 1. Whether you want to systematically improve your Chinese, prepare for the HSK 3.0 Level 1 exam, or simply experience modern Chinese life through engaging stories, this course offers a fun and effective way to learn.

This course continues to tell the story of Anne, Xiaobei, and Gao Tian's life in Beijing, and introduces a new friend, Bai Xue. Through their eyes, you’ll experience even more real-life moments: the joy of finding a lost wallet, a fun encounter with pandas at the zoo, helping a friend move, and exploring the beauty of Chinese landscape painting and the Mid‑Autumn Festival.

Through these engaging stories, you’ll learn how to deal with unexpected situations, ask for help when you need it, talk about your feelings, and discuss interesting cultural topics. The course fully covers the core vocabulary and grammar points of HSK 3, helping you practice Chinese in natural contexts, improve your communication skills, and make the leap from basic conversations to confident self‑expression.

Bai Suzhen falls in love with a mortal named Xu Xian, who had previously saved her life. However, Bai Suzhen is separated from her love and imprisoned beneath the Leifeng Pagoda by the Buddhist monk Fahai. Can Bai Suzhen reunite with Xu Xian after eighteen years of waiting? The Legend of the White Snake is not only a love story that transcends life and death but also a tale of rebellion against societal prejudice. 
This story is adapted from the folk tale “The Legend of the White Snake”, which has been passed down among the Chinese people for thousands of years, and is based on a vocabulary of 1,000 characters.

My human dad lives in Sweden. Because it was Mom’s birthday, Dad came to Japan to help her celebrate. They went out together, but when they got home, they found a cake in the doorway. Who was the cake from?

This is an original story based on a vocabulary of 150 characters.
course.title: I’m a Cat 4: Three Cakes

course.description:
This story tells of Bai Suzhen, a white snake demon who has cultivated for a thousand years, allowing her to transform into a beautiful woman. Bai Suzhen falls in love with a mortal named Xu Xian, who had previously saved her life. However, Bai Suzhen is separated from her love and imprisoned beneath the Leifeng Pagoda by the Buddhist monk Fahai. Can Bai Suzhen reunite with Xu Xian after eighteen years of waiting? The Legend of the White Snake is not only a love story that transcends life and death but also a tale of rebellion against societal prejudice. 
This story is adapted from the folk tale “The Legend of the White Snake”, which has been passed down among the Chinese people for thousands of years, and is based on a vocabulary of 1,000 characters.

Many years ago, Xiang’er and her two children walked all the way to the capital city to look for her husband, Chen Shimei. Xiang’er’s husband had left their home three years previously to take the national examination and had not been heard from since. Is her husband still alive? Will she be able to find her husband? 

Chen Shimei’s is a household name in China, and often appears in Chinese operas. This story is adapted from the Ming Dynasty novel “Cases of Judge Bao” and is based on a vocabulary of 1,000 characters.

course.description:
On a winter morning, a bloodstained garment is discovered hanging above the main gate of a market in the capital city of the Song Dynasty. A kidnapper had abducted the emperor’s biological father, leaving behind a message on the bloodstained garment. The message says that only Bao Zheng can save the emperor’s father. Bao Zheng is entrusted with this critical mission and begins investigating the case with his able assistant, Gongsun Ce. As the investigation deepens, all clues point to the palace. Certain deceased individuals and previously unmentioned past events come to the surface, revealing an epic tale of justice, love, and sacrifice …  

This story is adapted from a well-known traditional tale of the same name and is based on a vocabulary of 1,500 characters. This traditional tale has been adapted several times and featured both on the stage and on screen. Through this story, you’ll not only expand your Chinese vocabulary and grammar, but also gain a deeper understanding of ancient Chinese court culture and the traditional values of loyalty, courage, and wisdom.

title: Exchanging a Leopard Cat for a Prince

course.description:
On a winter morning, a bloodstained garment is discovered hanging above the main gate of a market in the capital city of the Song Dynasty. A kidnapper had abducted the emperor’s biological father, leaving behind a message on the bloodstained garment. The message says that only Bao Zheng can save the emperor’s father. Bao Zheng is entrusted with this critical mission and begins investigating the case with his able assistant, Gongsun Ce. As the investigation deepens, all clues point to the palace. Certain deceased individuals and previously unmentioned past events come to the surface, revealing an epic tale of justice, love, and sacrifice …  

This story is adapted from a well-known traditional tale of the same name and is based on a vocabulary of 1,500 characters. This traditional tale has been adapted several times and featured both on the stage and on screen. Through this story, you’ll not only expand your Chinese vocabulary and grammar, but also gain a deeper understanding of ancient Chinese court culture and the traditional values of loyalty, courage, and wisdom.

The story of the peach garden trio is universally known in China and is often alluded to as a symbol of fraternal loyalty. This story tells how three legendary figures from the period, Liu Bei, Guan Yu, and Zhang Fei, met and became sworn brothers. 

This story is adapted from a part of the novel “Romance of the Three Kingdoms”, one of the four great classic novels in Chinese literature, and is based on a vocabulary of 600 characters.

course.description:
After the dust settles from the Battle of Red Cliffs, Cao Cao, Liu Bei, and Sun Quan each consolidate their forces and establish the three states of Wei, Shu, and Wu, laying the foundation for the division of the Three Kingdoms. Liu Bei and Zhuge Liang take on the mission of reviving the Han dynasty, dreaming of unifying China. However, twists of fate leave the unfinished mission to Zhuge Liang’s disciple, Jiang Wei. In the midst of political intrigue and internal betrayal, Jiang Wei attempts to fulfill his mentor’s wish. In the face of numerous challenges, can he save the state of Shu, or is its fate already sealed?

This story is adapted from one of China’s Four Classic Novels, “Romance of the Three Kingdoms”, and is based on a vocabulary of 1,500 characters. “Reunification of the Three Kingdoms Under Jin” is the final story in this series, marking the end of the Three Kingdoms era.

This story is adapted from Edogawa Rampo’s novel Beast in the Shadows and is based on a vocabulary of 1,000 characters. This story contains some adult content, so please read at your own discretion.

course.description:
The zongzi and dragon boat races of the Dragon Boat Festival are the Chinese people’s way of honoring Qu Yuan. Qu Yuan was not only an idealistic statesman but also a remarkably talented poet. His life itself was a poem devoted to ideals and loyalty. This story takes you back over 2,300 years to experience the glory and sorrow of Qu Yuan and to feel the “spirit of home and country” and the enduring beauty of the “Songs of Chu”.

This story is adapted from “The Biography of Qu Yuan” in Sima Qian’s “Records of the Grand Historian” and is based on a vocabulary of 1,500 characters. It is aimed at learners who have completed the Upper Intermediate level and are beginning the Advanced level.

Fanfan and the big cat embark on a risky adventure to the cat paradise. They encounter various interesting animals on their journey, including a dangerous eagle and a mysterious lamb. Fanfan and Little Bai embark on the treacherous journey to the cat paradise, but along the way, they encounter the terrifying big eagle and the numerous dangers of the snowy mountain. What secrets is Little Bai hiding? Can Fanfan grow up from a little cat who loves to cry into a brave companion to Little Bai? Can Fanfan and Little Bai learn to trust each other in adversity and find a way out together? Find out the answers in this story about friendship and growing up.
This is an original story based on a vocabulary of 600 characters. If you are interested in the story of the little yellow cat, we also suggest that you read the “I’m a Cat” series.
course.title: Fanfan’s Story 3: Growing Up

course.description:
Fanfan and Little Bai come down from the snowy mountain, only to encounter the father of the big eagle. The father is even faster and stronger, and he is out to avenge his son’s death! During their escape, Fanfan and Little Bai meet the pika Yuanyuan and jump onto a mysterious camper van, only to fall into a new crisis. They walk through wind and rain, explore underground burrows, and try to avoid the pursuit of the big black eagle. Will they make it to the cat paradise? 

If you are interested in the story of the little yellow cat, we also suggest that you read the “I’m a Cat” series.

title: The 101 Store

course.description:
The Gao family’s jewels suddenly disappear, leaving behind an unsolved mystery. The room where the jewels were kept only has one door. How did the thief get in? The mystery arouses the intense interest of a detective named Bao Houan. According to the account of the Gao family, after the thief stole the jewels, he left behind a card indicating that he would come back to steal another priceless treasure that was as tall as a person. How could the thief pull off this heist with everyone watching? Can Bao Houan solve this mysterious case? Or will he end up putting himself in danger? What kind of mystery story will unfold?

This story is adapted from Edogawa Ranpo’s “The Fiend with Twenty Faces” and is based on a vocabulary of 1,500 characters.

The Gao family’s jewels suddenly disappear, leaving behind an unsolved mystery. The room where the jewels were kept only has one door. How did the thief get in? The mystery arouses the intense interest of a detective named Bao Houan. According to the account of the Gao family, after the thief stole the jewels, he left behind a card indicating that he would come back to steal another priceless treasure that was as tall as a person. How could the thief pull off this heist with everyone watching? Can Bao Houan solve this mysterious case? Or will he end up putting himself in danger? What kind of mystery story will unfold?

This story is adapted from Edogawa Ranpo’s “The Fiend with Twenty Faces” and is based on a vocabulary of 1,500 characters.

This secret chamber contains a mural depicting a pearl above a lotus flower. The pearl is offset slightly from the center of the mural, and there are also some mysterious black dots above the pearl. It is said that this mural may contain clues leading to ancient hidden treasure. How will the two adventurers interpret these mysteries and discover the truth about the ancient hidden treasure? 

This is an original novel based on a vocabulary of 2,500 characters. The novel is set in the mysterious and historically rich Dunhuang, and cleverly blends elements of traditional Chinese mythology, astronomy, and history into a treasure-hunting adventure that transcends time and space. The novel is not only an adventure filled with suspense and intrigue, but also an exploration of an ancient and mysterious culture that will deepen your understanding of China’s past.

course.description:
The emperor is obsessed with cricket fighting, and many mayors across the country send him their strongest crickets to win his favor. The mayor of Huayin City also wants to please the emperor, but there are no crickets in the area around the city. How can he find a strong cricket to send to the emperor?

This is an adaptation of Qing dynasty writer Pu Songling’s short story “The Fighting Cricket”. It reflects on the cruel society of the time and how something as small as a cricket can cause one person’s death and another person’s fortune.

This story is based on a vocabulary of 600 characters.

course.description:
The theft of a double-headed Buddha statue and a golden goose from the Shaanxi History Museum reveals a legend that has been hidden for a thousand years. Archaeologist Shi Wenqian and journalist Jian Xi team up to investigate, only to unexpectedly discover that the stolen treasures may be the key to an ancient mechanism. Can a mysterious ancient poem and a lost drawing really lead to the “Land of Eternal Life” of Qin Shi Huang? Can Shi Wenqian and Jian Xi unravel the puzzle woven from history and legend? 

This is an original story based on a vocabulary of 2,500 characters. By reading this story, you will not only build advanced reading skills but also gain exposure to a wealth of vocabulary and expressions related to Chinese history, culture, technology, and philosophy. The story also incorporates the “Records of the Grand Historian”, the theory of the Five Elements, archaeological knowledge, modern scientific theories, as well as the legends of Qin Shi Huang and the Terracotta Army. It is both thrilling and informative, making it perfect for Chinese learners who love adventure and history! 

If you are interested in this series, check out our other story in the same series—“The Dunhuang Code”.

title: The Magic Lotus Lantern

course.description:
The theft of a double-headed Buddha statue and a golden goose from the Shaanxi History Museum reveals a legend that has been hidden for a thousand years. Archaeologist Shi Wenqian and journalist Jian Xi team up to investigate, only to unexpectedly discover that the stolen treasures may be the key to an ancient mechanism. Can a mysterious ancient poem and a lost drawing really lead to the “Land of Eternal Life” of Qin Shi Huang? Can Shi Wenqian and Jian Xi unravel the puzzle woven from history and legend? 

This is an original story based on a vocabulary of 2,500 characters. By reading this story, you will not only build advanced reading skills but also gain exposure to a wealth of vocabulary and expressions related to Chinese history, culture, technology, and philosophy. The story also incorporates the “Records of the Grand Historian”, the theory of the Five Elements, archaeological knowledge, modern scientific theories, as well as the legends of Qin Shi Huang and the Terracotta Army. It is both thrilling and informative, making it perfect for Chinese learners who love adventure and history! 

If you are interested in this series, check out our other story in the same series—“The Dunhuang Code”.

course.description:
Dai Li wants to become an immortal who can live forever and never grow old. One day, he arrives in a magical place where a year lasts for one day, and all four seasons happen in the same day. He meets a beautiful girl in this magical world. But when he wakes up from his dream, they are separated again. This experience teaches Dai Li what the most important thing in life is.

This story is adapted from the short story “The Commandery of Cicadas” in the collection “Xie Duo” by the Qing Dynasty author Shen Qifeng and is based on a vocabulary of 1,000 characters.

course.title: Wen Ji

course.description:
In 2128, after his wife passes away, a doctor named Shu Wang discovers that he has a terminal illness that can not be cured by the medical technology at the time. Shu Wang chooses to go into a deep sleep pod to pause his life until future medical advances allow his illness to be cured. To stay close to his only daughter, Duoduo, he uploads his memories to the network before entering deep sleep, becoming a digital human with the ability to communicate with his loved ones. But what is true companionship? Can he find the true meaning of love between the digital and the real world? When real life and digital memories collide, what choices will Shu Wang and Duoduo make?

This is an original story based on a vocabulary of 600 characters.
course.title: Digital Dad

course.description:
In 2128, after his wife passes away, a doctor named Shu Wang discovers that he has a terminal illness that can not be cured by the medical technology at the time. Shu Wang chooses to go into a deep sleep pod to pause his life until future medical advances allow his illness to be cured. To stay close to his only daughter, Duoduo, he uploads his memories to the network before entering deep sleep, becoming a digital human with the ability to communicate with his loved ones. But what is true companionship? Can he find the true meaning of love between the digital and the real world? When real life and digital memories collide, what choices will Shu Wang and Duoduo make?

This is an original story based on a vocabulary of 600 characters.
course.title: Digital Dad

course.description:
Zhou Ming is the son of a wealthy and influential family. In order to meet his parents’ expectations, he travels to the capital city to seek success in the imperial examination. He is very lonely in this unfamiliar city until he meets a beautiful woman, who is also completely unlike a typical woman of the period. What changes will happen in his life?

This story is an adaptation of the Qing Dynasty author Pu Songling’s short story “A Gentleman of Jiaping”, based on a vocabulary of 1,500 characters.

course.description:
This is a heartwarming true story, hailed as the real-life version of the movie “Green Book”. It chronicles the touching friendship between a young Chinese man named Duke and a Bangladeshi rickshaw driver known as “Brother Yi”. Despite the hardships of life, “Brother Yi” always remains hopeful, while Duke illuminates the path ahead for his friend with genuine respect and practical help.

The story is told in plain, heartfelt language. As you read it, you’ll not only pick up useful Chinese expressions but also feel the sincerity and kindness that crosses borders.
course.title: Please Wait for Us

synopsis: In Dhaka, Bangladesh, a simple rickshaw ride brings Chinese traveler Duke together with the rickshaw driver “Brother Yi”. The two are the same age and are able to communicate in basic English, talking about life and the future. As they spend more time together, their chance meeting slowly grows into a genuine friendship.
title: Please Wait for Us

course.description:
During the Republican period, the “Seaside Bookstore” on Ninth Street seems to be a temple of knowledge at first glance but is actually a den of iniquity.  The police work diligently to unravel the mystery behind this urban legend. However, every time they are on the verge of uncovering the truth, the gambling den miraculously transforms back into a regular bookstore, leaving them baffled. How will Police Captain Guan Yiwen use his cunning to break through the enemy’s defenses? Can he uncover the truth about the casino?  

This story showcases a modern application of “deceiving the heavens to cross the sea”, the first stratagem from “The Thirty-Six Stratagems”, which was one of the two most important ancient military treatises in China alongside Sun Tzu’s The Art of War. How will Captain Guan Yiwen skillfully use this stratagem in the story? The answers are waiting for you to discover.  

This is an original story based on a vocabulary of 600 characters.

course.description:
In the bustling metropolis, police officers An Xin and Ma Xiangdong are caught up in a fight revolving around the mysterious owner of the “Seaside Bookstore”— “Brother Hai”. When they catch Brother Hai at the Dong’an Mall, a new character appears— the young and beautiful Jin Meimei, who claims to be Brother Hai’s boss. During the tense standoff, their police car is unexpectedly hit by another car … Will the police be able to successfully arrest Brother Hai?

The story cleverly integrates the second stratagem from the “Thirty-Six Stratagems”—“Besieging Wei to Rescue Zhao”, demonstrating the application of ancient wisdom in modern society. How will Jin Meimei use this strategy to her advantage? Let’s discover the answer together. Get ready to immerse yourself in a tale of mystery and suspense!

This is an original story based on a vocabulary of 600 characters.

In a Western-style house, four people are telling ghost stories late at night. The maid finally tells a story about a ghost hand that scares the lady of the house so badly that she can’t sleep that night.

“Ghost Hand” is a detective story by Sun Liaohong, written during the Golden Age of Chinese detective stories. Our adaptation of Sun’s story is based on a vocabulary of 1,500 characters.
course.title: Ghost Hand

synopsis: This is Part 7 of our rendition of “Ghost Hand”.
title: Ghost Hand

course.description:
After hearing that a large polar bear specimen at the Natural History Museum has been lost, reporter Sun Lin goes to the museum to investigate. According to a security guard at the museum, the polar bear specimen came alive and ran out of the museum by itself. How was this possible? Did someone steal the polar bear specimen? Why did they steal it?

This story is based on the novel “Secrets of the Museum” by Chinese detective writer Sun Liaohong and is based on a vocabulary of 1,500 characters. The story will be updated every Tuesday, so stay tuned!

course.description:
Following a string of bizarre disappearances, the house at number thirty-three in the mysterious Silk Garden housing development became famous as the “house that eats people”. Sun Lin’s investigation uncovered many clues, but many mysteries remain unsolved. Have the missing people really disappeared? What is the connection between fourteen playing cards and the rare exhibits? Can Sun Lin and the famous detective Ji Ping find the truth?
This adaptation of Sun Liaohong’s “The House at Number Thirty-Three” is based on a vocabulary of 2,500 characters.

course.description:
A Xiaomi cell phone is very fond of his owner, Daxing. Daxing’s girlfriend has a Chacha cell phone. However, Chacha does not like humans and wants to control them. Xiaomi knows about Chacha’s plan, but what will he do?

This original story is based on a vocabulary of 150 characters. For the story of Xiaomi and Daxing up until now, check out “Cell Phone 1: Together”.

One day Xiaomi meets Chacha who teaches him some tricks to get to spend more time with his owner. Can these tricks work?

This original story is based on a vocabulary of 150 characters.

course.description:
In an ordinary small town, the life of Gu Wanli’s family is completely changed by a mysterious monkey’s paw. This monkey’s paw can grant three wishes, but the fulfillment of each wish comes with an unexpected cost. As they make one wish after another, Gu Wanli and his wife Xia Shu discover that some things are far beyond their control … 
This story is adapted from W. W. Jacobs’s “The Monkey’s Paw” and is based on a vocabulary of 600 characters.

course.description:
As Gao Xincheng is walking home late one day, he notices a man in front of him that looks eerily similar to himself. Thrown off, he carefully follows as the man takes the same path as him toward his apartment. The man climbs the stairs to Gao Xincheng’s home, knocks on the door, and is happily let in by his wife! Is his wife having an affair? Who is this man?

This story is adapted from the short story “The Talisman” by Masao Yamakawa and is based on a vocabulary of 1,200 characters.

course.description:
He finally marries the girl he had a crush on when he was in college. In the bliss of their new marriage, he is happy every day and can’t wait to leave work and go home to be with his wife. One day, he comes home early to surprise his wife. But when he looks inside the room, he sees his wife secretly kissing a photo. Who was in the photo? Why did she kiss the photo and not want him to know about it? Will he find the answers?

This story is adapted from Edogawa Ranpo’s “Kiss” and is based on a vocabulary of 600 characters.

course.description:
There is a magical world where people can borrow time from the Bank of Time or from their family and friends. Those who borrow time become older, and those who lend time become smaller or even disappear. The Zhou (week) family has seven children. The five older brothers, Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, and Friday, work in the Bank of Time every day. The two younger brothers, Saturday and Sunday, do not have to work. One day, Sunday disappears. Where did he go? Can his six brothers find him?

This is an original story based on a vocabulary of 300 characters.

This is our adaptation of Japanese writer Akutagawa Ryūnosuke’s short story “The Nose”, based on a vocabulary of 300 characters.

course.description:
A family lives happily on Seventh Street, but one morning, their world suddenly collapses. The son, Gao Er, wakes up from his sleep in terror to find that he has turned into a beetle. Overnight, the pillar of the family becomes a horror that no one dares to mention, testing the family’s bonds. What will be the ultimate fate of the beetle Gao Er?

This story is adapted from Kafka’s “Metamorphosis” and is based on a vocabulary of 1,000 characters.
course.title: Metamorphosis

course.description:
Zhang Yang works in the local drugstore and is in love with his neighbor’s daughter. His friend He Fang is interested in the same girl, and asks Zhang Yang to mix a love potion so that he can win her love.

This story is based on a vocabulary of 600 characters.
course.title: The Love Potion

synopsis: This is the third part of our rendition of O. Henry’s short story “The Love-Philtre of Ikey Schoenstein”.
title: The Love Potion

course.description:
Old Lady Wang’s greatest wish is to have a grandson. Now that her daughter-in-law is pregnant again, can her wish come true?

This is an adaptation of the classic satirical novel by the famous Chinese novelist Lao She. Lao She often wrote about the real lives of Beijing citizens and was known for his very distinctive and realistic characters. This story highlights generational differences in the way people think about family.

This adaptation of Lao She’s story is based on a vocabulary of 1,500 characters.
course.title: Holding my Grandson

synopsis: Old Lady Wang’s daughter-in-law has already lost two babies. Will her daughter-in-law’s third pregnancy give her the grandson that she’s always wanted.
title: Holding my Grandson
